description: $0.05 USDC on Solana per audit - the payment buys one signed scope-hygiene audit of the one memory-store export you submit: the five factors individually (scope-field presence rate; unscoped-record rate; cross-scope identical-content clusters with their classifications; attribution/storage scope conflicts; duplicate clusters plus the live-duplicate rate), every unsupported factor stated NOT ASSESSABLE with its reason, and the coverage block. No composite score. The export is processed in memory only and is never stored.

family.description: The memory-store family of the export: mem0, zep_graphiti, letta, or generic.

form.description: The export form: full_text or hash_only.

manifest.description: Optional manifest declaring scope keys / sharing markers; a declaration replaces the family default scope-key set.

records.description: The export's records (up to 1,000; body up to 262,144 bytes). Processed in memory only and never stored.

variant.description: Optional family variant (e.g. zep_cloud for Zep/Graphiti).

name: scope_hygiene_audit
